rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides AI assistants with Google Calendar integration capabilities, built using Go with OAuth2 authentication and dual-mode operation supporting both standalone text display and MCP server functionality. The implementation offers calendar access through Google's Calendar API with flexible authentication options (file-based credentials or environment variables), containerized deployment support via Docker, and can operate in text mode for direct agenda viewing or MCP mode for AI assistant integration. Serves users needing programmatic calendar access through AI workflows, developers building scheduling applications that require Google Calendar integration, and teams wanting to enable AI assistants to read and interact with calendar data through a lightweight Go-based server.
